mfg1-surface-mock-07-practical-q01.stem: Before improvement 20 of 500 were defective; afterward 5 of 250. What is the rate comparison?
options: Counts alone show one quarter of the rate
reasons: Percent conversion is tenfold too large.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-practical-q02.stem: When choosing post-treatment to close anodic pores, what should be checked?
options: Hard coatings are identical for every use
reasons: Application and method are also necessary.
Consider dye retention, corrosion and wear tradeoffs.
Heat effects and specified conditions apply.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-practical-q03.stem: A customer reports the wrong quantity after manufacturing inspection passed. What is appropriate?
options: Investigate shipping records including logistics quality
Only change the inspection result to failed
Manufacturing passed, so it is outside scope
reasons: Items, quantity, timing and condition are customer requirements too.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-practical-q04.stem: An approved processor recycles offcuts into resources. Which activity is this?
reasons: It is not repeated use of an unchanged item.
It reprocesses material as a resource.
This is not authorized by the 3 Rs.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-practical-q05.stem: A tin bath is assumed harmless including every additive because tin is familiar. What is appropriate?
options: Check bath constituents, application and safety conditions
Immediately use everything for food contact
reasons: A metal name does not determine the whole bath's safety.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-practical-q06.stem: Omitting a thin strike by thickening the main coating is proposed. What is appropriate?
options: Check underlayer adhesion roles and the approved process
reasons: Main and underlayers have different purposes.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-practical-q07.stem: For a coil, right-hand fingers follow circulating current. What does the thumb show?

mfg1-surface-mock-07-practical-q08.stem: A 1:1 exercise titration uses 8.0 mL of 0.200 mol/L standard for 10.0 mL sample. What concentration results?
reasons: This is one decimal place too small.

mfg1-surface-mock-07-practical-q09.stem: Water droplets appear in a recess before molten-bath immersion. What is appropriate?
options: Hold immersion and check drying and shape requirements
reasons: Quantity alone does not establish safety.
